carmen.peopleops: Quick heads-up 1 1 new hire Manuel Rivera starts 2025-02-03. He uploaded a Mexican passport plus a U.S. permanent resident card (Green Card) but the vendor flagged the name with accent marks (Manue9l vs Manuel). BG vendor says they need a supporting doc or corrected consent. Also Manuel wants remote I-9 verification. @oscar.recruiter @it-provision

oscar.recruiter: Can we accept the Green Card for I-9 Section 2? Hefs remote and prefers a local notary. Also, Manuel asked whether Redwood reimburses notary fees.

carmen.peopleops: Green Card (Form I-551) is List A and acceptable if unexpired at time of verification. We must inspect originals. Local notary/authorized agent flow is fine. We reimburse reasonable notary fees up to $50 for remote hires per expense policy.

carmen.peopleops: For the BG name mismatch  vendor needs Manuel to sign a corrected consent that includes his full legal name and any diacritics. I just sent the corrected form. Once signed, vendor typically re-runs within 24-48h.

manuel.newhire: I can sign the consent now. I can also visit a notary this week  prefer evening. Any instructions for the notary?

carmen.peopleops: Paste this to Manuel (candidate-facing):

```
Hi Manuel  thanks. For remote I-9 verification you can use a local notary or other authorized agent to complete Section 2 of Form I-9 on or before 2025-02-03. Please have the agent inspect your original Green Card (Form I-551) or passport and complete Section 2. Ask them to print their name, title, company/firm, mailing address, date of verification, and phone/email. Scan or take a clear photo and upload to our secure intake portal: https://redwood-secure-intake.example/.

If you pay a notary fee, keep the receipt and submit it through expense.redwood.example (category: Onboarding reimbursements). We will reimburse up to $50. If you want, reply and I can book our vendor-assisted notary (no out-of-pocket).
```

oscar.recruiter: Nice. If4ll forward and ask Manuel which he prefers.

it-provision: Logistics note: we will ship laptop overnight to arrive by 2025-01-31. Network and SSO will be staged; full admin roles gated until BG is green and I-9 verified. If BG clears after Day 1 we can escalate access with manager approval.

bg-vendor-bot: Background check update: awaiting corrected consent signature for Manuel Rivera. Current hold reason: name normalization (accented characters). Expected re-run ETA: 24-72h after corrected consent is received.

carmen.peopleops: One more operational detail: if the notaryfs Section 2 scan is missing the agentfs address or phone, we must request a re-do. We can accept a vendor-signed verification letter in lieu of a local notary if the local agent refuses to provide contact details.

manuel.newhire: Signed the consent link and booked a notary for 2025-01-30 at 6pm local. I picked the "reimburse me" option.

oscar.recruiter: Thanks Manuel  If4ll confirm with GoodCheck when they get the signed consent.

i9-bot: Reminder: upload completed Section 2 to https://redwood-secure-intake.example/ within 3 days of verification to avoid onboarding delays.

it-provision: If reimbursement request is missing the notary receipt, forward it to me and If4ll follow up. Also tagging manager to hold off sensitive role grants until green.

carmen.peopleops: Closing note  once BG is green and I-9 Section 2 received we will notify IT to finalize access and badge provisioning. :white_check_mark:
